items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 11 July 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers much of the British Isles as a slow-moving but weakening frontal zone continues to affect Scotland.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the west and variable 2 to 4 in the east, becoming east or northeast 3 to 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly slight later, and occasionally moderate in the far southwest of the area.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate near some coasts.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast mainly 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
